scene_summary: A deckle-edged painted plate shows a turquoise sky of thick white clouds over a green meadow crossed by a vivid magenta flower band and a dark tree line. A large olive-khaki anime-style eye with a crescent pupil floats in the clouds on the right, while a faded blue-gray ghost eye hovers on the left and thin hair-like strands fall through the sky.
usable_surfaces: olive crescent-pupil eye in right sky
faded blue-gray ghost eye in left sky

detected_objects.label: Olive-khaki crescent-pupil eye floating in cloud-white sky
detected_objects.visual_evidence: Distinct olive-khaki spiky upper lash line with flicked outer corner, lower lid with barbed lashes, and a solid crescent-shaped iris enclosing cloud-white, positioned in the right-center sky; matches the planned anchor directly.
